statistical_power_basis.statement_audited: power bounded by <= 37.1% for large effects (d=1.25)
statistical_power_basis.source_document: Protocol v1.4 Section 9.2 (Table line 208) and Section 9.3 (item 1)
statistical_power_basis.mathematical_basis: At n=6 mechanisms, the signed-rank permutation space has 2^6 = 64 outcomes. Under a two-sided test, only the extreme outcome (W=0) yields p = 2/64 = 0.03125 < 0.05, while W=1 yields p = 4/64 = 0.0625 > 0.05. Furthermore, any tie reduces non-zero differences to m <= 5, where 2^5 = 32 and the minimum possible p-value is 2/32 = 0.0625 > 0.05, making rejection of H0 impossible. This bounds statistical power at <= 37.1% at the mechanism level, even though instance-level power (N=12) is 94.8%.
